articles.summary: Duke Energy Florida está lista para responder ante la amenaza de cortes de electricidad que representa el huracán Isaías en toda nuestra área de servicio. Los clientes se deben preparar ahora, seguir las advertencias de los funcionarios responsables de la administración de emergencias y mantenerse atentos durante toda la tormenta.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida está lista para responder e insta a sus clientes a prepararse para el huracán Isaías.

articles.summary: El huracán Isaías dejó atrás Florida esta mañana. Las cuadrillas ya han restablecido el servicio eléctrico a unos 10,000 clientes, y alrededor de 2,200 siguen sin electricidad en el norte de Florida. La compañía prevé finalizar los trabajos de restablecimiento esta tarde.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida concluye los trabajos de restablecimiento del servicio eléctrico tras el huracán Isaías. Las mejoras estratégicas de la red eléctrica beneficiaron a los clientes.

articles.summary: Given the Sunshine State has the second-highest electric vehicle (EV) registrations in the nation, Duke Energy Florida is reminding EV-driving customers about the range of programs the company offers to help them save money. For instance, since the Off-Peak Charging Credit program launched in 2022, enrolled customers have received a collective $1.5 million – in the form of bill credits – for changing their charging behavior.
articles.title: Plug in, get paid: Duke Energy Florida program offers bill credits for customers charging EVs at certain times

articles.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is investing $190,000 in South Carolina communities to strengthen downtown districts, neighborhood centers and commercial corridors. Funds will be used for facade improvements, wayfinding signage, public gathering spaces and small business incentive programs or microgrants.
articles.title: Duke Energy Foundation investing nearly $200,000 in South Carolina communities to support Main Street revitalization efforts

articles.title: Duke Energy prepares for Isaias’ rain and wind, encourages customers in SC Upstate and NC mountains to get ready

articles.summary: Duke Energy and stakeholders have reached an agreement that further protects existing customers from costs to serve data centers and other large-load customers in North Carolina.
articles.title: Duke Energy protects customers from data center costs

articles.summary: Duke Energy Florida is ready to respond as Hurricane Isaias threatens power outages across our service territory. Customers should prepare now, follow emergency management warnings and remain vigilant throughout the storm.

articles.summary: Hurricane Isaias cleared Florida this morning. Crews have already restored approximately 10,000, leaving about 2,200 customers without power across North Florida. The company anticipates wrapping up restoration this afternoon.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida wrapping up power restoration following Hurricane Isaias; strategic grid improvements delivered customer benefits
